question: What is the primary focus of safe motherhood initiatives?

options.A: Ensuring a healthy pregnancy and safe childbirth for every woman
options.B: Providing free formula feeding to all newborns
options.C: Increasing the birth rate in rural communities
options.D: Eliminating the need for traditional birth attendants

explanation: Safe motherhood focuses directly on the health and survival of women throughout pregnancy, delivery, and the postpartum period. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h1)

question: Why does safe motherhood include mental and social well-being alongside physical health?

options.A: Because total health affects a woman's ability to care for herself and her baby
options.B: Because mental health issues only occur after delivery
options.C: Because physical health cannot be measured during pregnancy
options.D: Because social status is the only cause of maternal mortality

explanation: A holistic view of health recognizes that emotional and social support are just as vital as physical care for a mother and her child. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h1)

question: Which of the following is one of the core pillars of safe motherhood?
explanation: Family planning is a foundational pillar that helps space births and protects women from high-risk pregnancies. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h2)

question: How does antenatal care directly contribute to saving a mother's life?

options.A: By preventing the mother from experiencing any labor pains
options.B: By identifying and treating potential complications before they become life-threatening
options.C: By guaranteeing that the baby will be born without any genetic disorders
options.D: By replacing the need for a skilled attendant during labor

explanation: Antenatal visits allow nurses and doctors to screen for conditions like high blood pressure and infections early, reducing emergency risks. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h2)

question: What does the first delay in the Three Delays Model refer to?

options.A: The time spent waiting for an ambulance on a bad road
options.B: The delay caused by nurses refusing to treat a patient
options.C: The time it takes for labor contractions to start
options.D: The delay in deciding to seek medical help

explanation: The first delay happens at the household or community level when family members fail to recognize danger signs or hesitate to seek care. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h3)

question: A pregnant woman in a remote village has severe bleeding, but her family wastes two hours trying traditional herbs before looking for transport. Which delay has occurred?

options.B: Delay in deciding to seek care

explanation: Waiting to seek help because of trying home remedies or not understanding the urgency represents the first delay in the model. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of using a partograph during intrapartum care?

options.A: To test the mother's blood sugar levels
options.B: To register the baby's name after birth
options.C: To calculate the total cost of hospital delivery
options.D: To monitor the progress of labor and detect problems early

explanation: The partograph is a visual tool used by nurses and midwives to track labor progress and maternal-fetal well-being. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h4)

question: Why is the immediate postpartum period considered the most critical time for postnatal care checks?

options.A: Because breast milk production stops if not checked immediately
options.B: Because most maternal deaths from bleeding happen shortly after delivery
options.C: Because the mother's blood pressure always drops to zero
options.D: Because the baby cries continuously during the first few hours

explanation: Postpartum hemorrhage is most likely to occur immediately after the placenta is delivered, making early observation essential. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h4)

question: Which service is provided in a Comprehensive EmONC (CEmONC) facility that is NOT part of a basic facility?

options.B: Provision of iron and folic acid supplements

explanation: Major surgeries like caesarean sections and blood banking are what upgrade a facility from basic to comprehensive EmONC. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h5)

question: A patient arrives at a primary health clinic with a severe postpartum hemorrhage that requires a blood transfusion. What should the nurse do?

options.A: Send the patient home with oral pain relievers
options.B: Stabilize the patient and quickly arrange transfer to a CEmONC facility
options.C: Perform a major surgical operation right there in the primary clinic
options.D: Wait for the bleeding to stop on its own before taking action

explanation: Basic clinics cannot handle blood transfusions or major surgery, so quick stabilization and emergency referral are mandatory. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h5)

question: What is a primary responsibility of a nurse-midwife during antenatal care visits?

options.B: Performing major obstetric surgeries at primary clinics
options.C: Educating mothers on danger signs and proper nutrition
options.D: Building new roads for easy transport to hospitals

explanation: Nurse-midwives play a key role in health education, teaching women what to expect and when to seek urgent help. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h6)

question: Why is building a trusting relationship between the nurse and the pregnant woman so important?

options.A: It encourages the woman to report health problems and return for follow-up visits
options.B: It prevents the husband from being involved in family health decisions
options.C: It eliminates the need for any laboratory tests during pregnancy
options.D: It guarantees that the baby will be born without any complications

explanation: Trust reduces anxiety and ensures women feel safe sharing their symptoms and returning to the facility for care. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h6)

question: What does intersectoral collaboration mean in the context of safe motherhood?

options.A: Leaving health matters exclusively to medical doctors
options.B: Closing down primary health centers to build markets
options.C: Working together with different sectors like transport, education, and health
options.D: Transferring all pregnant women to foreign countries for treatment

explanation: Maternal health is influenced by many factors outside the clinic, requiring cooperation across multiple government and community sectors. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h7)

question: Why is it important to involve men and community leaders in safe motherhood programs?

options.A: They are the only ones allowed inside antenatal care wards
options.B: They are trained to perform emergency caesarean sections
options.C: They often control household finances and transportation decisions
options.D: They replace the need for professional nurses in the village

explanation: In many settings, men hold the decision-making power regarding money and travel, making their buy-in crucial for emergency care. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h7)

question: Which of the following is a major barrier to safe motherhood in Nigeria?

options.A: An overabundance of fully equipped emergency hospitals
options.B: Too many skilled midwives working in remote villages
options.C: Free transportation services for all pregnant women
options.D: Inadequate health infrastructure and out-of-pocket spending

explanation: Poor facilities and the burden of paying out-of-pocket for treatment prevent many Nigerian women from getting timely care. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h8)

question: What is the main purpose of monitoring and evaluation in maternal health programs?

options.A: To punish nurses who make mistakes during night shifts
options.B: To track progress, spot system weaknesses, and guide proper resource use
options.C: To reduce the number of women attending antenatal care
options.D: To increase the cost of medications in government clinics

explanation: Monitoring and evaluation provide data that shows what is working and where urgent improvements are needed in the healthcare system. [learn more](GNS214_U1_T44#GNS214_U1_T44_h8)
